# Docs

All things GitHub Authentication and, more specifically, `authnd` documentation.

## Where do I start?

Start off with [What Is Authnd?](what-is-authnd.md).

Then, head over to [How We Develop](authnd-development.md) to learn a bit about how we work,
also [How We Experiment](how-we-experiment.md) for more info on how we use science experiments to safely change production code.

If you're going to be on-call, or otherwise responsible for "operations", check out the [Playbook](https://ops.githubapp.com/docs/playbooks/authnd.md).

## Format

* All docs should be in Markdown format unless impossible for a good reason
* Docs should not wrap at 80 columns, but use [semantic line feeds](https://rhodesmill.org/brandon/2012/one-sentence-per-line/)
